### 2. Your role

Independent cost advice from written instruction/complete inputs to named final output and query-period end. Estimate uncertainty is explicit; no guaranteed tender, final cost, approval or funding.
Designers/specialists define design, compliance, retained-system adequacy and remediation; operator supplies equipment/owner costs; PM owns budget/change approval. QS prices gaps, administrator directs/certifies, advisers own tax/legal/valuation. Disclose client/contractor/lender conflicts.
Cost basis: Confirm purpose/users; construction versus total-project boundary; currency/tax adviser, budget/date/approval, quality, measurement method, price date/location and escalation endpoints. Attach current revisions, contracts/quotes and conflicting identities/dates.

### 3. Scope by stage

Confirm base stages, inputs and final query-period end; later services require written instruction. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Inception / cost basis | Reconcile brief, budget, scope/area/quantity definitions and evidence; establish source, gap, risk and priced-assumption registers, reporting/program and input owners |
| S4 Design cost planning | At named milestones measure/price agreed documents; coordinate services/siteworks, test value options with designers, reconcile changes/budget and risk/owner costs; flag gaps before freeze |
| S5 Procurement / tender (option) | Separately select pretender estimate, BoQ/schedule, packages, clarifications/interviews/negotiation and recommendation; agree measurement rules/contractual quantity status. D&C/ECI design/risk allowances and tender-budget reconciliation. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S6 Post-contract cost advice (option) | Named contract; counted claims/variations, observations, cost reports/cashflow and forecast. Separate claimed, assessed/certified, paid, committed/disputed/forecast; reconcile PC/PS, contingency and client costs. Administrator retains powers; lender reliance separate. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S7 Final account (option) | Reconcile contract sum, variations/allowances/claims, commitments and risk; scoped retention/defects advice, unresolved disputes and final registers. Completion certification, entitlement and security release remain contract roles. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 4. Allowances

Complete counts before issue. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate with quantity; options separately totalled. Construction provisional sums do not authorise consultant fees.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plans / options | 2 cost issues; stages/buildings/packages, alternatives, maturity/quantity basis and total-project extent | Review / meetings | 2 feedback rounds; draft/final issues, meetings/duration, authority discussions and advice-hour ceiling |
| Visits / access | 2 visits/hours; sites/areas, access/induction/travel and named specialist investigations; no hidden-work verification | Tender services | 2 packages; bills/schedules/tenders, clarification/interview hours and reconciliation issues |
| Post-contract / completion | 2 months; claims/variations or hours ceiling, reports/visits, final-account rounds, defects/retention period and extension rates | Specialist options | 2 reports/scenarios; purpose/extent/horizon, drawdowns, reliance users and extra inputs/inspections |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Construction cost plan at selected stages; measured/assumed quantities and missing specialist inputs recorded; Total project budget: fees/charges, off-site, FF&E, land/finance/tax; item boundaries and tax adviser agreed; Fit-out/refurb/live-site strip-out, make-good, isolation, after-hours and decanting; designers assess retained systems; Operator equipment/specialist operations; evidenced requirements or explicit allowances only; Escalation, risk register and sensitivity; dated endpoints, no duplicate contingency/margin.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Tender/D&C/ECI review; normalise qualifications, PC/PS and alternatives; no novation or superintendent role; Progress-claim reports; separate brief/inspection counts and administrator authority; Lender reports; separate brief, inspections and reliance, never implied by progress-claim advice; Life-cycle/carbon/LCA analysis; horizon/assumptions stated, designers approve performance effects; no compliance certification.
Excluded: the party named does it: Valuation, insurance replacement value and tax depreciation (named valuer / insurer / tax adviser (R4)).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Agree Project cost appointment (attached), version/precedence and written departures; no unavailable standard terms or conflicting purchase-order terms by implication.
- Written authority before extra scope, ceilings/counts, later stages or fee/program change; give cause, alternatives and effects. Report material unpriced gaps/budget overruns promptly.
- Facts, revisions, selected stages, counts, positions and addenda set baseline; purchased design development/review is included.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Correct invoices for completed work payable within 30 days, subject to agreement/applicable requirements. Disclose advance payment, interest, suspension, minimums and withholding.
- Agree rate-validity date and escalation, unused allowances, cancellation/standby and remobilisation; no inherited annual increase.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23; answers go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Dated PDFs/editable quantity/rate/reconciliation workbooks; source cutoff, units, rate evidence, preliminaries/margin, PC/PS, gaps, risk/escalation/tax and confidence limits. Agree project distribution licence, separate lender reliance, proprietary-data limits, confidentiality/security/retention and handover.
- Competent resources/independent review, substitutions/conflicts and selected insurance; disclose liability/indemnity/loss/novation/IP/contamination departures. Agree notice/cure, completed/committed costs, records transfer, negotiation/mediation and urgent relief.

### 7. Evaluation

Evaluated price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Named team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Check cost basis, independence, insurance and departures first; normalise counts, input maturity, coverage, reliance and options. Lowest price need not win.

R2 Deliverables list: Each report/BoQ/workbook/register: purpose/scope, input cutoff, format/editability, recipient/reliance, dates/rounds and confidence. Include reconciliation, unpriced gaps and authority versus budget differences.
R3 Hourly rates: Personnel and extra plan/option/update/meeting/visit/tender/claim/variation rates, ceilings, duration extensions/travel/cancellation/escalation; quantity assumptions and authority before exceedance.
R4 Team: Lead, measurer/estimator, services specialist/reviewer/subconsultants, stage availability/conflicts and ISO or equivalent QA. Assign design/quantity/operator/owner/authority/tax inputs and claim assessor/certifier/payer.
R5 Experience: Two or three matching building/work/purpose/procurement/maturity and existing/live/staging examples; personal role, deliverables, forecast lessons and referees.
R6 Departures: Sections 3-6/agreement: comply/departure or nil; reason, alternative, fee/time effect, owner/date/evidence. Resolve identity/date, meeting/update/rate conflicts and unpriced gaps. Assumptions state extent/quantity, basis and consequence; unknown cost is not zero.
R7 Program: Start/complete-input conditions, owners/due dates, cutoff/draft/review/final, authority/design/tender milestones, optional reporting cycle and appointment end; pauses/update triggers/consequences.
R8 Insurance and compliance: Current PI $5 million (client selected), PL $20 million (client selected), workers evidence; project-selected limits before issue, claim/aggregate/expiry/exclusions and task-specific competence/registration. Old certificates establish no current cover.
R9 Reimbursables: Travel/site, investigation/data access, authority/lender and specialist costs: included/allowance/unit, quantity/payer/GST/markup/approval. Identify client-direct costs; no R1 or budget duplication.
